content.text:
This is a rich topic with a lot of current data to draw from. Here is a comprehensive, well-sourced overview of the leading lifestyle hotel brands an owner should consider when positioning a hotel in the Caribbean and Latin America (CALA) around differentiated guest experience and local character:

---

# Lifestyle Hotel Brands to Consider for the Caribbean & Latin America

The CALA region is experiencing a surge in demand for experiential, culturally rooted hotel stays.

citations.cited_text: Luxury Hospitality — High-end hotel brands are differentiating through curated programming that turns accommodations into platforms for culture, welln...
citations.title: Curated Travel Experiences : Caribbean & Latin America

content.text: High-end hotel brands are differentiating through curated programming that turns accommodations into platforms for culture, wellness, and experiential discovery.

citations.cited_text: Conor Lawler from Sandals added, Guests are looking more and more for authentic local experiences and not just the status quo. They want to experience...
citations.title: Executive Roundtable: Caribbean and Latin American Lodging Markets - Hospitality Net

content.text: Guests are looking more and more for authentic local experiences — they want to experience the differences in the different locations.

For owners, selecting the right lifestyle brand is critical to capturing this demand. Here are the top brands to evaluate:

---

## 🏨 HILTON'S LIFESTYLE PORTFOLIO

citations.cited_text: Across lifestyle brands, Hilton continues to expand its footprint in nearly 20 countries and territories, reinforcing rapid growth and meeting high‑de...
citations.title: Hilton Ends 2025 with Robust Luxury and Lifestyle Growth, plus New Signings Across the Caribbean and Latin America | WebWire

content.text: Across its lifestyle brands, Hilton continues to expand its footprint in nearly 20 countries and territories, reinforcing rapid growth and meeting high‑demand for culturally relevant, distinctive experiences.

### 1. **Curio Collection by Hilton**
This is arguably Hilton's most active lifestyle brand in the region right now.

citations.cited_text: Propelled by heightened traveler demand for curated, experiential stays, landmark openings included Waldorf Astoria Costa Rica Punta Cacique, an ocean...
citations.title: Hilton Ends 2025 with Robust Luxury and Lifestyle Growth, plus New Signings Across the Caribbean and Latin America | WebWire

content.text: Landmark openings have included Zemi Miches Punta Cana All‑Inclusive Resort, Curio Collection by Hilton, set along 2,000 feet of pristine beach in the Dominican Republic, and York Medellín, Curio Collection by Hilton, which debuted in Colombia as the city's first Curio lifestyle hotel.

citations.cited_text: Notable signings in 2025 include WIA Ushuaia, Tapestry Collection by Hilton in Argentina; Casa di Sirena Sao Paulo Pinheiros, Curio Collection by Hilt...
citations.title: Hilton Ends 2025 with Robust Luxury and Lifestyle Growth, plus New Signings Across the Caribbean and Latin America

content.text: Notable 2025 signings also include Casa di Sirena Sao Paulo Pinheiros, Curio Collection by Hilton; Casaway Mata Atlantica Morretes, Curio Collection by Hilton in Brazil; Almare Beach Resort Las Terrenas, Curio by Hilton in the Dominican Republic; and Cabo Hotel Guatape El Peñol, Curio Collection by Hilton in Colombia.

Curio is a strong fit for independent-minded, one-of-a-kind properties that want chain-scale distribution without losing their unique identity.

### 2. **Tapestry Collection by Hilton**
Tapestry is another soft-brand option within Hilton's lifestyle family that has been gaining traction.

citations.cited_text: Notable signings in 2025 include WIA Ushuaia, Tapestry Collection by Hilton in Argentina; Casa di Sirena Sao Paulo Pinheiros, Curio Collection by Hilt...
citations.title: Hilton Ends 2025 with Robust Luxury and Lifestyle Growth, plus New Signings Across the Caribbean and Latin America

content.text: 2025 signings under Tapestry include WIA Ushuaia in Argentina, Chelsea Bogota Parque 93 in Colombia, and Sozo Paramaribo in Suriname.

citations.cited_text: By the end of 2026, the company plans to open Casa Costa Ilhabela, Curio Collection by Hilton in Brazil, Montara Hotel, Tapestry Collection by Hilton ...
citations.title: Hilton Caps a Record Year in the Caribbean and Latin America With a Growing Luxury Pipeline

content.text: By the end of 2026, Hilton also plans to open Montara Hotel, Tapestry Collection by Hilton in Costa Rica.

Tapestry suits independent hotels with strong local character that want Hilton's Honors loyalty platform without conforming to a rigid brand standard.

### 3. **Canopy by Hilton**

Additionally, Hilton has focused on expanding its lifestyle offerings with brands like Canopy by Hilton and Tapestry Collectio
citations.title: Hilton Expands Its Reach in the Caribbean and Latin America, Surpassing More than Three Hundred Hotels and 150 New Projects in 2025 - Travel And Tour WorldTravel And Tour World

content.text: Hilton has focused on expanding its lifestyle offerings with brands like Canopy by Hilton and Tapestry Collection

across the region. Canopy is designed around neighborhood immersion and local discovery, making it well-suited for urban and resort gateways where a "live like a local" guest narrative is a priority.

### 4. **Motto by Hilton**
A more micro-hotel, urban lifestyle format,

citations.cited_text: By the end of 2026, the company plans to open Casa Costa Ilhabela, Curio Collection by Hilton in Brazil, Montara Hotel, Tapestry Collection by Hilton ...
citations.title: Hilton Caps a Record Year in the Caribbean and Latin America With a Growing Luxury Pipeline

content.text: Hilton plans to open the brand's first-ever Motto by Hilton in Brazil with Motto by Hilton Recife Antigo

— indicating growing regional appetite for this concept. Best suited for dense urban markets where space efficiency, social design, and a lively F&B-forward approach can differentiate the guest experience.

---

## 🏨 MARRIOTT INTERNATIONAL'S LIFESTYLE PORTFOLIO

citations.cited_text: ... Marriott International Caribbean & Latin America is leaning into luxury travel, positioning several of its brands around immersive programming tha...
citations.title: Luxury at Marriott Hotels in the Caribbean and Latin America

content.text: Marriott International Caribbean & Latin America is leaning into luxury travel, positioning several of its brands around immersive programming that extends well beyond the hotel itself — whether clients want a multi-destination itinerary, authentic cultural experiences, or simply a chance to slow down and embrace a destination's rhythm.

### 5. **Autograph Collection**
One of Marriott's most active lifestyle conversion brands in CALA.

citations.cited_text: In the first quarter of 2025 alone, Marriott opened six luxury properties in the Caribbean and Latin America: The St. Regis Aruba Resort; Salterra, a ...
citations.title: What’s New for Marriott in the Caribbean and Latin America | TravelAge West

content.text: In Q1 2025 alone, Marriott opened the all-inclusive Waves, Autograph Collection, Barbados; Treasure Beach, Autograph Collection, Barbados; and Clevia, San Miguel de Allende, Autograph Collection.

citations.cited_text: Just minutes away from this landmark destination, The Brown, Autograph Collection, engages in a natural dialogue with its surroundings by weaving toge...
citations.title: A Journey Through Museums and Hotels in Latin America and the Caribbean with Marriott International

content.text: The Brown, Autograph Collection in Guatapé, Colombia, engages in a natural dialogue with its surroundings by weaving together design, nature, and local authenticity — with a museum visit becoming a seamless extension of the hotel experience, inviting guests to connect with the destination's creative spirit.

Autograph is ideal for hotels with strong architectural heritage or culturally distinctive design narratives.

### 6. **Tribute Portfolio**
Tribute Portfolio is Marriott's soft brand for independent hotels that want to retain their identity while gaining access to the Bonvoy loyalty ecosystem.

citations.cited_text: Credit: 2025 Marriott Caribbean and Latin America · “The opening of Recoleta Grand marks an exciting chapter for Tribute Portfolio as we continue to e...
citations.title: What’s New for Marriott in the Caribbean and Latin America | TravelAge West

content.text: Recoleta Grand in Buenos Aires joined Tribute Portfolio, and Brian King of Marriott noted it "captures the essence of what makes the brand so compelling — distinctive design, vibrant spaces and an authentic connection to place."

citations.cited_text: Among these is the Tropical Hotel da Amazônia, which is slated to join the Tribute Portfolio in 2026, alongside further expansions of the Westin and A...
citations.title: Marriott International Is Transforming Travel in the Caribbean and Latin America: Here’s What It Means for Your Next Trip! - Travel And Tour WorldTravel And Tour World

content.text: The Tropical Hotel da Amazônia is also slated to join the Tribute Portfolio in 2026.

Best for owners of destination-defining properties who want minimal brand intrusion.

### 7. **W Hotels**
W Hotels is Marriott's boldest lifestyle brand, anchored in design, nightlife, and music culture.

citations.cited_text: The Ancestral Flavors of Cacao and Rum at W Costa Rica Reserva Conchal ... In Guanacaste, W Costa Rica Reserva Conchal elevates tasting into a cultura...
citations.title: Marriott Invites Travelers to Discover Latin America Through Authentic Cultural Experiences

content.text: W Costa Rica Reserva Conchal, for instance, elevates local culture through experiences like a Rum & Chocolate Tasting that brings together aged rum and artisanal chocolate crafted from locally sourced cacao, reflecting the profound historical relationship that Mesoamerican cultures have maintained with cacao.

W is the right fit for high-energy beach or urban destinations where design-forward, social guests are the core target.

### 8. **The Luxury Collection**
While positioned above pure "lifestyle," The Luxury Collection functions as a strong choice for unique heritage or resort properties seeking to anchor their story deeply in place.

citations.cited_text: Nestled between the Sierra Madre mountains and the Pacific Ocean, the retreat offers a slower, more personalized approach to experiencing Mexico'...
citations.title: Marriott International Caribbean & Latin America Invites Travelers to Embrace This Season's Top Luxury Travel Trends

content.text: Siari Riviera Nayarit, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve (a sister ultra-luxury brand), exemplifies this ethos — nestled between the Sierra Madre mountains and the Pacific Ocean, with indigenous artistry woven into the resort's design and cuisine that celebrates Mexico's heritage.
For the lifestyle positioning itself, properties like

citations.cited_text: At The Santa Maria, a Luxury Collection Hotel & Golf Resort, recently honored with the Forbes Travel Guide Recommended Rating 2026, the coffee exp...
citations.title: Where Luxury Is Felt: Singular Experiences in Latin America's Most Inspiring Destinations, According to Marriott International

content.text: The Santa Maria, a Luxury Collection Hotel & Golf Resort in Panama, elevate local experiences to luxury through the distinguished Geisha café, connecting guests to Panama's rich coffee heritage.

---

## 🏨 HYATT'S LIFESTYLE PORTFOLIO

citations.cited_text: Since 2017, Hyatt has doubled its number of luxury rooms, tripled its number of resort rooms, and quintupled its number of lifestyle rooms globally.
citations.title: Hyatt Grows Luxury and Lifestyle Brand Footprint Across the Americas Region

content.text: Since 2017, Hyatt has quintupled its number of lifestyle rooms globally

, and the CALA region is a major focus.

### 9. **Andaz**

citations.cited_text:
Andaz, translated from Hindi, means "personal style." Designed for those with a global sensibility, Andaz hotels are 
grounded in their local surroun...
citations.title: Hyatt Hotels Corp - Form ARS - FY2025

content.text: Andaz, translated from Hindi as "personal style," is designed for those with a global sensibility — hotels grounded in their local surroundings and infused with local culture, with personalized, attentive service that leaves guests feeling empowered to explore themselves and the world around them.

citations.cited_text: Thompson Palm Springs (expected ... Collection by Hyatt in 2024) In 2025, Hyatt plans to introduce several luxury and lifestyle brands in markets acro...

content.text: Andaz Miami Beach opened in December 2024, and Andaz Mayakoba in Mexico (formerly an Andaz property) has been rebranded as Alila Mayakoba.

Andaz is one of the most compelling lifestyle brand choices for owners who want a genuine local-culture philosophy baked into brand standards.

### 10. **Thompson Hotels**

Thompson Hotels
Thompson Hotels provide a sophisticated home base when traveling. The brand is focused on the classics done with a 
refined sensibil...
citations.title: Hyatt Hotels Corp - Form ARS - FY2025

content.text: Thompson Hotels provide a sophisticated home base when traveling — focused on the classics done with a refined sensibility and distinctive sense of style, housed in an environment where culture thrives, juxtaposing classic and modern sensibilities to deliver a culturally rich environment that blends business and leisure.

citations.cited_text: Thompson is one of Hyatt’s sharpest lifestyle assets — urban, stylish, and expanding abroad. It walks a fine line between boutique personality and cha...
citations.title: Every One of Hyatt’s Brands, Explained (2025)

content.text: Thompson is one of Hyatt's sharpest lifestyle assets — urban, stylish, and expanding abroad — walking a fine line between boutique personality and chain hotel polish, and largely getting the balance right.

An excellent fit for urbane coastal or city hotels targeting design-conscious travelers.

### 11. **The Standard**

citations.cited_text:
The Standard
The Standard hotels create culturally-inspired, socially-driven entertainment destinations in some of the world's most 
inspiring locat...
citations.title: Hyatt Hotels Corp - Form ARS - FY2025

content.text: The Standard hotels create culturally-inspired, socially-driven entertainment destinations in some of the world's most inspiring locations.

Now part of Hyatt following the acquisition of Standard International, The Standard's reputation for F&B programming, nightlife, and cultural curation makes it highly relevant for markets like Tulum, Cartagena, or San Juan.

### 12. **The Unbound Collection by Hyatt**
This is Hyatt's soft-brand collection for one-of-a-kind, independent-minded hotels.

citations.cited_text: Alila Mayakoba (expected to resume operations in 2025 after rebranding from Andaz Mayakoba) will mark the debut of the Alila brand in Latin America an...
citations.title: Hyatt Launches Unscripted by Hyatt, a New Upscale Collection Brand in the Essentials Portfolio | Hotel Online

content.text: Alila Mayakoba marks the debut of the Alila brand in Latin America and the Caribbean, offering a wellbeing sanctuary with holistic wellness experiences deeply connected to local culture and sustainability.

The Unbound Collection allows maximum creative freedom for the owner while accessing World of Hyatt's loyal global membership base.

### 13. **Alila**

citations.cited_text: Alila Mayakoba (expected to resume operations in 2025 after rebranding from Andaz Mayakoba) will mark the debut of the Alila brand in Latin America an...
citations.title: Hyatt Launches Unscripted by Hyatt, a New Upscale Collection Brand in the Essentials Portfolio | Hotel Online

content.text: Alila Mayakoba (which rebranded in 2025) marks the debut of the Alila brand in Latin America and the Caribbean, offering a wellbeing sanctuary with a collection of 182 rooms and a Spa Alila offering holistic wellness experiences deeply connected to local culture and sustainability.

Alila is a premium choice for resort owners focused on wellness, sustainability, and deep environmental immersion.

---

## 🏨 BRANDED RESIDENCES — A KEY OWNER CONSIDERATION

Across all of the above brands, mixed-use positioning with branded residences is becoming a major differentiator in the region.

citations.cited_text: According to panelists at the 2025 Caribbean Hotel Investment Conference & Operations Summit discussing luxury mixed-use trends in the region, providi...
citations.title: News | Luxury hotel developers say Caribbean is primed for branded residences, personalized experiences

content.text: Providing branded residences is a win-win scenario for owners who can see a faster return on investment with buyers coming in on the rental units, which also get used as rental inventory.

citations.cited_text: "For mixed-use developments with residential, most of our projects are going to have that component," said Carlos Crovato, head of development, lifest...
citations.title: News | Luxury hotel developers say Caribbean is primed for branded residences, personalized experiences

content.text: As Carlos Crovato, Head of Development (Lifestyle) at Hyatt, noted: "The market is asking for them and owners are very much interested in getting [that component]."

---

## Summary Matrix for Owners

| **Brand** | **Parent** | **Best Fit** | **Local Character Approach** |
|---|---|---|---|
| Curio Collection | Hilton | Unique resorts & urban hotels | Soft brand; property retains identity |
| Tapestry Collection | Hilton | Independent boutiques | Independent spirit + Hilton distribution |
| Canopy by Hilton | Hilton | Urban/neighborhood immersion | Local discovery programming |
| Motto by Hilton | Hilton | Micro-urban lifestyle | Social design, F&B forward |
| Autograph Collection | Marriott | Heritage/design-led properties | "Exactly Like Nothing Else" positioning |
| Tribute Portfolio | Marriott | Fully independent properties | Soft brand; full identity retention |
| W Hotels | Marriott | High-energy beach/urban | Bold design, music, nightlife culture |
| The Luxury Collection | Marriott | Iconic destination properties | Deep sense-of-place storytelling |
| Andaz | Hyatt | Resort & urban, culture-first | Local culture philosophy embedded in standards |
| Thompson Hotels | Hyatt | Urbane coastal/city hotels | Refined, culturally rich environment |
| The Standard | Hyatt | Trendsetting cultural hubs | Social, F&B, events-driven culture |
| Unbound Collection | Hyatt | One-of-a-kind independents | Maximum creative freedom + loyalty access |
| Alila | Hyatt | Wellness-resort destinations | Holistic wellness, sustainability, local roots |

---

**Bottom line for owners:** The CALA lifestyle segment is fiercely competitive but richly rewarding for properties that commit to genuine local character. Soft-brand collections (Curio, Tapestry, Autograph, Tribute, Unbound) offer the lightest brand touch with the largest distribution networks — ideal for conversion plays. Hard lifestyle brands like Andaz, W, Thompson, and The Standard bring the strongest guest experience frameworks and F&B/programming infrastructure for new-build or repositioning projects where the owner wants brand-led differentiation rather than just distribution.
